name: stack-panel
title: Stack Panel
description: Open a project and swipe right to go back
useCases: In compact settings, a user moves from the root menu into notification preferences and then goes back one level.
In product help, a reader picks a topic. The app displays the associated content in the same panel through renderPanel.
task: Open a project and swipe right to go back

models.StackPage: type StackPage = { title: string; rows?: Row[]; content?: ReactNode };

behavior: Use items and renderPanel for a flat menu. For nested navigation pass a pages map and the initial root key.
